arguments.content:
# Dot hero: showSongInfo enabled with long metadata, ensure no overlap/clipping.
# Requires drive.py regression runner.

mode own
screen dot
# Load fixtures (10) as queue so metadata/tags are present.
call ext.nothingness.setQueue paths=/opt/nothingness/media/01-undercover-49.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/02-undercover-50.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/03-undercover-51.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/04-undercover-52.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/05-undercover-53.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/06-undercover-54.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/07-undercover-44.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/08-undercover-45.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/09-undercover-46.opus,/opt/nothingness/media/10-undercover-47.opus startIndex=0
play
pause

# Normal text size (1.0)
settings open
call ext.nothingness.tapByKey key=void-settings-dot-show-song-info
# text size slider: drag far right to 1.5, then back to normal is hard; instead set to max first, then set normal by drag less.
# We'll assume default is 1.0; after enabling overlay we keep as-is.
settings close
shoot dot_songinfo_normal

# Maximum text size (1.5)
settings open
call ext.nothingness.tapByKey key=void-settings-dot-show-song-info
call ext.nothingness.dragByKey key=void-settings-dot-text-size dx=400 dy=0 steps=25
settings close
shoot dot_songinfo_max
